project_name: Victron SmartShunt IP65 300A - Local Venus OS Integration

data_states.current: Data age <= 90s, Connected == 1, Identity match valid -> Normal active glow
data_states.stale: Data age > 90s and <= 180s -> Warning state (Yellow/Amber badge, stale indicator)
data_states.unavailable: Data age > 180s OR Connected == 0 OR Identity match invalid -> Error/Offline state (Muted/Red badge, greyed out values)

optional_sensors.rule: Only render Midpoint Voltage (Mittelpunktspannung/Abweichung), Starter Battery Voltage (Starterspannung), and Temperature (Temperatur) if values are actively provided by physical hardware. Hide or mark as N/A when non-existent without breaking card layout.

device_history.rule: Use native hardware device counters / history values provided by Venus OS / SmartShunt instead of calculating energy, Ah, or cycles on the frontend.

responsive_rules.no_nested_cards: Flat SCADA panel grid layout without deep nesting
responsive_rules.no_usage_explanations: Pure technical SCADA display without tutorial/marketing explanatory copy

data_testid_policy: All interactive elements (tabs, refresh button, toggles, filter buttons) and critical informational metrics (voltage, current, power, soc, remaining time, status badge, identity badge) MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build the SmartShunt preview strictly at /smartshunt-preview as a standalone tabbed view with tabs: Übersicht, Gerät, Diagnose, Verlauf.
Do NOT touch main navigation or modify existing Trucki / SUN control routines.
Ensure read-only MQTT / Venus OS logic (instance 290) is mocked or wired to local endpoints without VRM cloud calls or acoustic alarms.
Adhere to the exact color scheme: Cyan (#06B6D4) for SmartShunt Battery, Amber (#F59E0B) for PV, Rose/Pink (#EC4899) for House, Violet (#8B5CF6) for Grid.
Display positive values (+W / +A) as Charging (Laden) and negative values (-W / -A) as Discharging (Entladen).
Manage 3 data states strictly: Fresh (<=90s), Stale (90s-180s), Unavailable (>180s or Connected=0 or invalid identity).
Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, tabs, input options, and key metric cells.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain flat white cards.
Use SCADA dark theme with glassmorphism and subtle metallic hairlines.
Keep mobile layout (390px) responsive and clean without overflow.
Avoid decorative AI emojis in icons.
Ensure all tests can query elements via data-testid.
